items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: The drummer. Jimmy, they had a big fella, he died.

ctx.x: The drummer. Jimmy, they had a big fella, he died. He was playing a funeral across the road there. He used to play the tour. He died. He got sick and died. I believe he died on the way. I think he did. He told me it was coming from one of the other sides of Gretchen. Yeah. I never knew it.
It wasn't Eddie Jackson. No, it wasn't Eddie Jackson.
